problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate a fleet of specialized cargo vessels to fulfill delivery orders across a network of regional ports.  

The vessel capacity available at each departure hub (set H) is as follows:  
*H1 can dispatch up to 111 units of cargo.  
*H2 can dispatch up to 191 units.  
*H3 can dispatch up to 132 units.  
*H4 can dispatch up to 122 units.  
*H5 can dispatch up to 147 units.  
*H6 can dispatch up to 169 units.  
*H7 can dispatch up to 186 units.  
*H8 can dispatch up to 141 units.  

The required delivery volume at each receiving port (set P) is specified below:  
*P1 must receive 68 units.  
*P2 must receive 166 units.  
*P3 must receive 88 units.  
*P4 must receive 151 units.  
*P5 must receive 135 units.  
*P6 must receive 142 units.  
*P7 must receive 60 units.  
*P8 must receive 38 units.  

The per‑unit transport expense from each departure hub to each receiving port is given in the table:  

| From / To | P1 | P2 | P3 | P4 | P5 | P6 | P7 | P8 |
|-----------|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|
| H1 | 11 | 14 | 2  | 19 | 8  | 5  | 1  | 9  |
| H2 | 18 | 19 | 19 | 14 | 10 | 5  | 7  | 11 |
| H3 | 8  | 13 | 19 | 8  | 16 | 18 | 11 | 9  |
| H4 | 16 | 16 | 15 | 6  | 12 | 6  | 5  | 18 |
| H5 | 16 | 6  | 18 | 2  | 17 | 2  | 3  | 2  |
| H6 | 1  | 14 | 5  | 8  | 3  | 5  | 1  | 7  |
| H7 | 17 | 15 | 12 | 2  | 20 | 20 | 16 | 16 |
| H8 | 1  | 1  | 18 | 18 | 14 | 1  | 1  | 17 |

Determine the optimal allocation of cargo units from hubs to ports so that the total operational expenditure is minimized.
